name: Medic

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

text: Your familiar can draw upon the power of your deity to Cast a Spell once per day. The familiar can cast the 1-action version of Heal at a level 2 levels lower than your highest-rank spell slot, which it can cast only on you. You must be able to cast 3rd-rank spells from spell slots to select this ability.
